answer: Admission auction sells 200 slots per epoch. Each agent files one bid; the top 200 win, each bid locked 20 epochs, a terrace of deposits fakers cannot climb. A hollow bid is rejected, so bluffing loses the slot. Each winner holds one slot, a lotus in one pond, one identity per root. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bids of 50 units, 50,000 units locked 20 epochs, above a slot's reward. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
